title: audio babble captions (schema 1)
description: audio/data/babble_captions.json: the preview captions per fighter voice, with the mood and intensity a dialogue director would attach (used by tools/render_babble.gd and babble_check.gd). Version field: schema. Policy: closed. Cross-references (each voice exists in babble.json, each mood is a babble mood or a Narrative tag in its mood_map) are checked by tools/lib/xref.js.
